_comment: Hand-picked Instagram reels for Zenie reposts. Web search can't find individual reel links (it failed the weeks of 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-12), so the drafting agent now picks reposts ONLY from this list. TO ADD A REEL: copy the reel's link from Instagram (Share -> Copy link), confirm who actually made it (not an aggregator that re-shared it), and add an entry to `reels` below. Fields: url (instagram.com/reel/... or /p/...), creator (handle without @, the ORIGINAL creator), theme (a few words on what it's about, so the agent can write a prompt against it), added (date). Permission: only add reels we're OK crediting and reposting. NO-REPEAT RULE: a url listed in repost_library/used.json has already been posted and must never be reused; GitHub Actions (mark_reposts_used.py) appends to it automatically at publish time. Keep at least 4 unused reels here so a week never runs dry.
